name: Zenith Firaga (XVI)
effects:
Seven single hybrid attacks, grants [Blessing of the Phoenix] to party, grants [Attach Fire 3 with Stacking], Cap Break Level 1, Ultimate Mode to user
Blessing of the Phoenix: When HP falls below 50%, HP Recovery, [Fire Ability Damage +50%, Dualcast Fire, Instant ATB & Instant Cast] for 1 turn to user, removes Blessing of the Phoenix
Ultimate Spirit Mode: En-Fire Damage +20% & Black/White Magic Casting Speed x1.1
Ultimate Dexterity Mode: Dualcast Black Magic/White Magic, Higher Multiplier & Zero Hone Cost to Hero Ability; Firaga (XVI)+: Higher multiplier & Cap Break Level 1 after 3 uses; Curaga (XVI)+: 1.2s CT
Ultimate Vitality Mode: +1500 max HP & Astra to user
